headline: Government Adopts Decision: 100% of Shares of Electric Networks of Armenia Recognized as Public Priority Interest
summary: The government recognized 100% of the shares of Electric Networks of Armenia as public priority interest. The decision was adopted at its October 15 session.
why: Electric Networks of Armenia is the country's main electricity distribution company, so decisions about its ownership affect the power sector and investors in the utility. Public priority designations can enable state intervention in private shares.
